 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE B.N. KARIA  Date : 22/04/2018  ORAL ORDER
This Criminal Revision Application is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat, today.
Learned APP Shri JK Shah appearing on behalf of the respondent-State has produced Withdrawal/Settlement purshis, which is taken on record.

The said purshis is duly signed by authorized person Shri C.S. Gohil, who is identified by Shri D.R. Sharma, Law Officer of the Food and Drugs Control Department, who is also present before this Court stating that he has no objection, if the matter is disposed of as per prevailing police.
All the concerned parties have put their signature on the said withdrawal purshis.

As such, on going through the record, it is noticed that the offence alleged against the original accused-revisionist R/CR.RA/502/2005 ORDER under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act,
1954 is not serious in nature and the punishment or penalty for such offence is not substantial, and in view of the provisions of Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006, it is Ghanshyambhai Kanaiyalal Mehta vs The State Of Gujarat on 22 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107500284/
1 compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.

sentences.text:
It is pointed out that by virtue of an Order dated 8th July 2005 passed by this Court, pending hearing and final disposal of the present Criminal Revision Application, the execution,
implementation and operation of the impugned judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 9th February 1992 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Navsari in Criminal Case No. 841 of 1992 and which was confirmed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Valsad vide judgment and order passed in Criminal Appeal No. 9 of 1998 dated 30.06.2005 has been suspended and the applicant/revisionist is ordered to be released on bail.
In view of purshis of the parties, the present Criminal Revision Application stands disposed of.

The applicant/revisionist is hereby directed to pay fine of Rs. 25,000/= [Rupees Twenty Five thousand only] before the High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court of Gujarat Complex, Ahmedabad within a period of four weeks of this Order; as agreed, failing which the Criminal Revision Application shall stand revived automatically.
Accordingly, this Criminal Revision Application stands disposed of as settled on payment of fine; as aforestated.
